note: Forbidden: a Request Authenticator that is not 16 random octets, or one drawn from a predictable source. TestRFC2865RequestAuthenticatorRandom substitutes crypto/rand.Reader and asserts the authenticator equals the substituted octets byte for byte (a counter or constant goes red), and asserts two successive values differ; the width is the [AuthenticatorLen]byte type. Single-polarity marker on the row covers the missing negative.
